translationRepairs: Heaven gives you ale and you refuse—is there poison inside?
His Majesty gives you wine to drink, yet you refuse. Is there something harmful in it?

天 repeats the court designation of His Majesty in s0081/s0082/s0088/s0092; the sentence also explicitly asks 中有惡物邪, whether there is something harmful in the wine. Preserve that question and the reported accusation in both fields.
